Cook, staff and customer browser workflows against the real local stack (Playwright, Chromium)

scenario_results.observed: Browser journey (scripts/dev.sh e2e): the first POST /api/v1/orders reaches the server and commits, then the response is aborted; the customer web shows the retry prompt, the retry with the stored keys shows the existing order and the database holds exactly one order for the customer. A mutation using fresh keys on retry failed the journey. Component tests: both attempts carry the same Idempotency-Key and clientRequestId, keys are stored before sending and cleared with the cart afterwards; after a reload a stored pending placement is resolved by the by-request lookup without a new POST.

Component tests: discovery shows a retry action after a server error and an empty state after retry; signed-out checkout asks to sign in with a return address to the cart; an offline banner reacts to the browser offline event; placement shows the server reason for definitive errors and never shows success without a server order. Browser journey: loading and success states through discovery, cart, quote and order page.

Browser journey on PostgreSQL, Keycloak, S3 emulator and API: customer-b searches the customer web, opens the published meal, chooses a slot, adds it to the cart, signs in through Keycloak and returns to the cart, adds a delivery address in the UI, gets a server quote (synthetic policy warning, cash on receipt), places the order (lost-response retry) and follows it: the cook accepts, prepares and marks it ready in the operations web; the customer page shows ACCEPTED, then the handover code; the cook dispatches and enters the code; the customer page shows COMPLETED. A pickup order is then placed; the customer's order list shows both. Arabic RTL default verified.

findings: Stable-key placement verified in the browser against the real API; mutation detected.
No client-side prices; server reasons shown for definitive errors.
Residual: draft visual design until O05 (P06 gate blocked on O05); synthetic phone verification in the journey.
